title: Rebate
description: One manufacturer or dealer incentive program attached to a new-vehicle listing. program_value is in whole units of the enclosing Vehicle.currency (USD when omitted). A rebate never changes the meaning of Vehicle.price: an unconditional rebate (is_conditional false) is already reflected in price and MUST NOT be subtracted again; a conditional rebate (is_conditional true, the default) is never reflected in price and is only a possible additional saving for buyers who qualify.

program_id.description: Stable identifier of the incentive program, unique within one rebates array. JSON Schema cannot compare array members by one field, so publishers and receivers check uniqueness.

program_number.description: Optional manufacturer or lender program number, as printed on the incentive bulletin.

program_value.description: Rebate amount in whole units of the enclosing vehicle's currency (USD when omitted).

is_conditional.description: true (the default when omitted): the buyer must meet eligibility conditions, such as military service, loyalty, recent graduation or financing with a named lender; never reflected in price. false: available to every buyer and already reflected in price when price is present.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone offset after which the program no longer applies. Publishers remove expired programs; consumers MUST NOT present a rebate after this time.
